goals.title: Community goals
goals.intro: The whole server works towards one target, shown on a bar at the top of everybody's screen. Everybody who gave at least the least share gets each tier's reward.

players.title: Players
players.intro: Everybody Polaris has dealt challenges to on this server, most recent first.
players.none: Nobody has been dealt challenges yet.
players.name: Player
players.resetBody: What they were dealt on this server is forgotten and dealt again the next time they are on. Their season points and streak stay, and nothing is taken from them in the game.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pace: Targets follow how many finish them
settings.paceHint: Over 80% done moves a challenge's targets up 15%; under 20% moves them down.
settings.linkedOnly: Only players linked to a Polaris account
settings.joinMessage: Say how many are left when a player joins
settings.bossBar: Show the tracked challenge on a bar
settings.afk: Nothing counts while a player stands still
settings.xray: Anti X-Ray catches lose the day's mining
settings.seasonStartHint: Empty: the day challenges were switched on.
settings.catchUp: Last two weeks pay x1.5 below the middle tier
settings.shared: Share one season with other servers
settings.sharedHint: Players linked to a Polaris account add up their points and streak across every server of yours with the same group name. Everybody else stays per server.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.intro: Challenges pay season points and levels. Items come from season milestones, sweeps and the bingo card, so the season's item budget stays in one place.
rewards.comeback: Welcome back after a week away (points)

catalogue.title: Challenges on offer
catalogue.intro: 86 challenges in 11 categories, measured only with what the game counts. Switch off a category or a single challenge, and weight a category to see it more often.
catalogue.uncertain: How the game counts this one is not certain on every version; it only comes up rarely.
